title: Act 3 - Chapter 5: Mt. Silver Summit & The Ultimate Convergence
synopsis: With all 16 Badges in hand, return to Pallet Town to report to Professor Oak. Cynthia and Blue alert you to a catastrophic Spacetime Anomaly detected atop Mt. Silver. Pass through the unlocked Route 26 gate, navigate the treacherous multi-tier caverns of Mt. Silver, and battle Blue for HM10 Rock Climb. Scale the frozen bluffs, defeat Sinnoh Champion Cynthia, breach the temporal vortex, and duel legendary Johto Champion Gold atop the snowbound summit to claim your true endgame victory and the Shiny Charm.
